title: pm: the Notify: security doorbell reads a private repository's card as OWNER/REPO#N
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x3ZJ3vUAa9xu4fhtKsK3Vp6)_

Fixes #31103

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads no path-derived model mandate for this surface; any mandate above this thread's model would be waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). The dispatching seat runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `Notify: security` 门铃新增一种读法 `Notify: security · OWNER/REPO#N`（私有仓里那张普通 `security` 卡，读出仓库和卡号），裸 `#n` 仍只表示分诊挂标的公开卡；pm-dispatch 三处参考行把私有仓门铃写成 `OWNER/REPO#N`。
- 为什么改：PR #31102 让私有仓的安全发现建普通 `security` 卡并以裸 `#N` 敲 `security#1`，该号不指明仓库，安全席分不清私有仓卡和误公开卡，也打不开卡（#31102 契约复审 S2）。
- 风险与回滚：只改 pm 工具的读法与三行文字；新读法只带卡引用，不带机制、路径、对象名或发现编号；三个文件行数不变、每行 ≤120 B；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `REPO_CARD_REF` 与 `'notify:security'` 读者，及新增两条自测。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test`，预期退出 0，`368 cases pass`。
- 需要你做的：无。Tier 由 `check-governed-merges` 读出，本分支读为 Tier S（`.claude/**`），席位契约复审后落地。

## What changes

### Grammar, before and after

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Template | `Notify: security · GHSA-ID or #n` | `Notify: security · GHSA-ID or OWNER/REPO#N or #n` |
| `GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx` | `{ advisory, numbers: [] }` | unchanged |
| `#n` (triage's labelled public card) | `{ card, numbers: [n] }` | unchanged |
| `OWNER/REPO#N` (private repository's ordinary `security` issue) | unreadable | `{ repo, card, numbers: [] }` |

`when` gains one branch: "or the finding is on a PRIVATE repository and the seat filed an ordinary `security` issue there: that card as `OWNER/REPO#N` ALONE". `from` and `to` are unchanged.

- **Shape reused, not invented.** `REPO_CARD_REF = /^([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)#([1-9][0-9]*)$/` is the repository-qualified card reference `check-half-states.mjs` already reads (`Restart-when: closed <owner/repo>#N` at L3385, `re-check owner/repo#N` at L7008): two segments, each led by an alphanumeric. It is mirrored, not imported, because that module is not a recogniser and the regex is not exported there. The looser `REPO_SHAPE` (`mailbox-open.mjs`, `issue-create.mjs`) admits a leading `.`, so it was not used.
- **`numbers` stays empty** for the qualified form, as it does for the advisory id: `numbers` lists numbers on this board, and a private repository's `#N` is not one.
- Still one field: a qualified ref beside an advisory id, a public `#n`, a path or free text is unreadable.

### Self-test cases and counts

Two pins added to the battery `⭐ the mailbox doorbell …`, floor raised **42 → 44** (by exactly the two pins added, recorded beside the 41 → 42 note). Self-test total 366 → **368** cases, exit 0.

1. ⭐ `Notify: security · objectstack-ai/cloud#412` under `To: security#1` reads `repo: 'objectstack-ai/cloud'`, `card: 412`, no `advisory`, `numbers` empty; `my.org-1/a_b.c-d#7` reads its repository; the bare `Notify: security · #29761` still reads `card: 29761` with no `repo` and `numbers: [29761]`.
2. ⛔ unreadable (14 lines): no slash (`objectstack-ai#412`), three segments, empty owner, empty repo, owner led by `.`, `#0`, space before `#`, trailing letters, the template `OWNER/REPO#N`, and the qualified ref beside a GHSA id (either order), beside `#29761`, beside a path, beside free text.

The existing pins still hold: the bare `#n` pin (L2869 on main), the "template sent verbatim is not an event" pin (the new template stays unreadable), and the both-ways key-name pin against `project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉.

### Line readings (`.claude/**`, in place, net 0 lines)

```diff
--- a/.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md  (L63, 105 → 115 B)
-- 席位两件事:照第 3 节建私卡;敲 `Notify: security · GHSA-ID`(私有仓 `#N`),只带编号。
+- 席位两件事:照第 3 节建私卡;敲 `Notify: security · GHSA-ID`(私有仓 `OWNER/REPO#N`),只带编号。
--- a/.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md  (L48, 104 → 119 B)
-- 持发现的席→`security#1`:私卡建成或误公开卡挂标即 `Notify: security`,只带编号。
+- 持发现席→`security#1`:私卡建成或误公开卡挂标即 `Notify: security`,只带编号或 `OWNER/REPO#N`。
--- a/.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/security.md  (L16, 117 → 118 B)
-- 接收 ①:发现者的一次 `Notify: security · GHSA-ID`(私有仓 `#N`)门铃,私卡已由其经中继建好。
+- 接收 ①:发现者 `Notify: security · GHSA-ID`(私有仓 `OWNER/REPO#N`)门铃,私卡已由其经中继建好。
```

Bytes are measured without the newline. Line counts are unchanged: `security-findings.md` 65/65, `project-forms.md` 59/59, `lanes/security.md` 53/53. No ceiling was raised and no line was re-wrapped or merged. To fit 120 B, L48 drops `的` from `持发现的席`, and L16 drops `的一次`; the single-ring rule keeps its home in `project-forms.md` L51 (no re-sends on any key). `lanes/security.md` L49 (`Notify: security · #N`) is triage's public-card hand-over, so it is left alone.

### Other consumers

No other `scripts/pm` reader uses the parsed fields. `check-half-states.mjs` H72 reads only each event's `state` (read or not) through `mailboxEvents`. `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` names the row only in a comment. Nothing else imports `readMailboxLine` or reads `.card`, `.repo` or `.advisory` from it.

## Why

PR #31102 (#30114) made a security finding on a private repository an ordinary `security` issue on that repository, and its holder rang `security#1` with a bare `#N`. The reader only read a bare `#n` as triage's labelled public card, so the security seat could not tell which repository the card was on, or tell it from a mis-disclosed public card except by the sender. This is should-fix S2 of the contract review of PR #31102 (comment 6704473385).
